product_updates.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
product_updates.content: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.

product_updates.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
product_updates.content: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.

product_updates.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
product_updates.content: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?

product_updates.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
product_updates.content: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.

product_updates.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
product_updates.content: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.

product_updates.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
product_updates.content: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.

product_updates.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
product_updates.content: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.

product_updates.title: Spotify’s current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
product_updates.content: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explains why the rise of AI agents could be good news for the music service.

product_updates.title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
product_updates.content: Claude Duet is available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users.

product_updates.title: Nirva raises $33M for a pendant that only listens to you
product_updates.content: Nirva will ship its $249 ambient AI pendant by the end of the year.
